core_categories: Medical Devices; Medical Equipment; Consumables; Critical Care; Respiratory Care; Patient Care
specialty_focus: Insan Bakti is a fully integrated Malaysian healthcare corporation and market access provider, acting as a distributor of medical devices, equipment, and consumables to public and private hospitals, clinics, and research centers. Its specialty focus covers critical care, anesthesiology, operating room solutions, trauma care, respiratory care, gastroenterology, pediatrics, cardiology, home care, and sleep medicine. It does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices.
